headlines.title: Ferrovial wins $538M Texas water project
headlines.summary: The reclamation work in Fort Worth, to be delivered by subsidiary Webber, is the firm’s largest water infrastructure project in the U.S. to date.

headlines.title: Ferrovial wins $538m Fort Worth water reclamation facility contract
headlines.summary: The new Fort Worth facility is expected to be completed by summer 2030 and will treat 10 million gallons of wastewater daily.

headlines.title: Citi upgrades Ferrovial as I-24 payment structure eases cash concerns
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Citi upgraded infrastructure group Ferrovial NV to "buy" from "neutral" on Wednesday, saying the fall in its shares since it won the I-24 toll road concession does not reflect the project’s underlying economics.

headlines.title: What Ferrovial (FER) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
headlines.summary: Ferrovial (NASDAQ:FER) reported strong growth in its highways and construction businesses during the first nine months of 2026, while providing additional details on recently awarded managed-lanes projects in Tennessee and Georgia.

headlines.title: Ferrovial (FER) Q3 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
headlines.summary: Construction order book hits EUR 19 billion all-time high amid major U.S. managed lane awards.

description: Ferrovial N.V., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development, construction, and operation of highways and airports in the United States, Poland, Spain, the United Kingdom, Canada, and internationally. It operates through four segments: Construction, Highways, Airports, and Energy. The company is involved in the development, financing, and operation of toll road infrastructure and construction activities, including the design and construction of public and private works; construction of public infrastructures; and development, financing, investing, and operation of airports. It engages in the development and construction of energy transmission and renewable generation energy infrastructure, as well as rendering of services regarding energy efficiency; and operation of waste management plants. The company was founded in 1952 and is based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.
